title: Filtered Derivative (Discrete or Continuous)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time filtered derivative, 1 input, 1 output; {Gain} sets the derivative gain, {Time constant} sets the derivative time constant, {Upper saturation limit} sets the output upper limit, {Lower saturation limit} sets the output lower limit, {Minimum sample time to time constant ratio} sets the discrete ratio, {Initialization} sets the initial state specification Inherited from block, {Initial state} and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: Output upper limit inf (default) | real number

params.name: Minimum sample time to time constant ratio
Initialization
params.values: Initial state specification Inherited from block input (default) | Specify as parameter
